recommendation.reason: Agentic Lean-proof benchmark with 244 expert-formalized open problems, executable kernel verification, 42% best score, and containerized tasks; T2 applies.
risks: Some tasks may be independent or unprovable under the protocol.
Solutions could leak if benchmark problems are later solved and published.
Formalizations may subtly differ from the intended conjectures.

tasks.quote:
The benchmark has 244 problems. Each one is a conjecture or an expressly open
problem stated in a paper or report from an undergraduate research program.

verifier.full_credit: A submitted patch that proves the Lean theorem, or proves its full negation, is accepted by the Comparator check.
verifier.quote: Given a *Lean file* with an open *problem*, a model is tasked with generating a *patch* that either proves the theorem or proves its full negation.

oracle.quote:
The test evaluates a one-problem dataset whose submitted refutation must be accepted.
It is skipped, not passed, when Docker or the image is unavailable.

network_or_api: model endpoints for the Leanimum-agent prediction generator (litellm/openrouter/portkey)
credentials: model provider API keys for prediction generation (evaluation itself should run without credentials)
exceptions: shared image is linux/amd64 and runs under emulation on ARM/M-series hosts
about 15GB image; keep at least 60GB free
two Comparator processes per worker, so -j must match available CPUs/memory
runtime.quote:
ReuF2F evaluation runs untrusted Lean code and can be resource intensive.
> Use a disposable host without credentials or sensitive data.
